svg.title: From the schedule to the admit card
svg.desc: The school sets the day and time of each exam subject. Only when all subjects are set does the exam reach families. When you tap the admit card, the server checks that the parent is linked to this child, that the child has a seat in a published seat plan, and whether the school's rule holds it back for dues. If all is well, the admit card print page opens.
